noeuds.role: Compares a variable's value with a number or a text.

noeuds.nom: If Object A touches Area B
noeuds.schema: Inputs: Object A, Zone B  →  Output: True / False
noeuds.role: Instantly checks whether two objects overlap at this exact moment.
Lets you check two conditions at the same time.
noeuds.exemple: if (Player on ground) AND (Jump button pressed) → jump.

noeuds.role: Checks whether the object is on screen, or whether it has the requested tag.
Runs an external Blueprint saved in the "fonctions" folder.
noeuds.exemple: create a "SpawnMonsters" function you can reuse in all your levels.

noeuds.role: Splits execution into several branches to structure and organize your Blueprint's logic.
Temporarily blocks the rest of the Blueprint for a set delay.
noeuds.exemple: limit a fire rate (wait 1 sec between each bullet).

noeuds.schema: If Joystick Active · If Moving · If Button Held · If Off Screen
noeuds.role: Quick test blocks with outputs (True / False) depending on the current state.
